title: Consistency Learning and Distillation for One-Step MIMO-OFDM Channel Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2611.06271v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Iterative neural channel estimators can improve recovery under pilot contamination, but repeated network evaluations increase inference cost. This paper develops observation-anchored consistency and Consistency Mid-Training (CMT) estimators for one-step channel estimation in multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) systems. Both estimators refine pilot-derived least-squares channel estimates in the delay-beam domain. Consistency learning couples endpoint predictions along noisy-to-clean paths. CMT then refines a compact consistency-trained student to predict a flow-matching teacher's endpoint from intermediate trajectory states. Across the evaluated SNR range, the compact CMT student reduces uncoded symbol error rate (SER) by 9.6-20.2% relative to the one-step flow-matching baseline (0.44-0.98 dB in logarithmic SER reduction), while using 74.5% fewer parameters and 73.0% fewer network multiply

translated_title: 面向一步式MIMO-OFDM信道估计的一致性学习与蒸馏
translated_abstract: 迭代式神经信道估计器能够在导频污染条件下改善信号恢复效果，但反复的网络推理会增加计算成本。本文针对多输入多输出正交频分复用（MIMO-OFDM）系统中的一步式信道估计，提出了观测锚定一致性估计器和一致性中期训练（Consistency Mid-Training, CMT）估计器。两种估计器均在时延-波束域中对基于导频的最小二乘信道估计进行精炼。一致性学习将带噪到干净路径上的端点预测相互耦合。CMT随后对一个紧凑的、经一致性训练的学生模型进行精炼，使其能够从中间轨迹状态直接预测流匹配教师模型的端点结果。在所评估的信噪比范围内，紧凑的CMT学生模型相比一步式流匹配基线，将未编码符号错误率（SER）降低了9.6-20.2%（对数SER降低0.44-0.98 dB），同时参数数量减少74.5%，网络乘法运算减少73.0%。
tldr: 本文提出观测锚定一致性学习与一致性中期训练（CMT）蒸馏方法，实现MIMO-OFDM系统的一步式信道估计，紧凑的CMT学生模型在参数减少74.5%的情况下将符号错误率降低9.6-20.2%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes observation-anchored consistency learning and Consistency Mid-Training (CMT) distillation for one-step MIMO-OFDM channel estimation, where the compact CMT student achieves 9.6-20.2% SER reduction with 74.5% fewer parameters than the one-step flow-matching baseline.
